summary.intent: Run the GSD research and requirements-definition phases for the CipherBox v2.0 metadata-and-sharing refactor, producing ARCHITECTURE.md, PITFALLS.md, SUMMARY.md, and REQUIREMENTS.md.
summary.outcome: Both research agents completed with high confidence; SUMMARY.md was written manually after the synthesizer agent was blocked from writing files; 36 requirements across 8 categories were written to .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md and committed to the docs/v2.0-metadata-and-sharing-refactor branch.

repo: packages/core is the keystone package in the 8-layer build order; FUSE budgets a Windows CI round-trip.
.planning/research/ is gitignored, so stale v1.1 research files persisted unnoticed until manually inspected.
v1.1 requirements used per-domain REQ-ID prefixes; v2.0 uses fresh category prefixes (CRYPTO, NODE, READ, ROT, WRITE, TEE, DATA, TEST).
folder_ipns table has a public_key null-row footgun that must be addressed in the DATA phase (rename to ipns_records, drop public_key column).
AAD byte-drift between TS and Rust causes silent total decryption failure — TS↔Rust KAT is Phase 1's gate requirement.

code.finding: 36 requirements: CRYPTO(3), NODE(6), READ(5), ROT(7), WRITE(4), TEE(7), DATA(4), TEST(3). Critical risks: CRIT-1 fileKey mint bypass, HIGH-3 multi-rooted re-mint, HIGH-4 add-during-rotation silent data loss, M1 generation persistence.
Written manually by the main agent after synthesizer subagent was blocked from file writes; serves as roadmapper input.

workflow: Synthesizer subagents can be blocked from writing files — have the orchestrator write the output itself from the returned text rather than retrying the subagent.
Stale research files from prior milestones should be archived before spawning new researchers to avoid confusion about what is current.
The gsd phase helper had trouble with git signing in sandboxed contexts; direct git commands work as a fallback.

friction: Synthesizer agent was blocked from writing SUMMARY.md, requiring the main agent to write it manually.
gsd git helper failed due to signing/sandbox restrictions; had to fall back to direct git commands for the commit.
agent-skills query returned empty output, requiring a separate inspection step to confirm the researcher agent carries its own prompt.
Stale v1.1 research files were present in .planning/research/ and had to be archived before v2.0 research could begin cleanly.
open_items: Tier 3 capability layer and read-side TTL deferred to Future Requirements.
Three silent-revocation-bypass risks (CRIT-1 fileKey mint, M1 generation persistence, republisher seq-increment) and HIGH-4 add-during-rotation must be test-gated — not yet implemented.
folderTree/SDK desync risk identified in research but not yet addressed.
Windows CI gate for winfsp/desktop (TEST category) is a requirement but not yet wired up.
